gloss: to make a mistake; to mess up

definitions.gloss: to make a mistake; to mess up; to screw up
definitions.explanation: To make an error or do something incorrectly.

examples.english: I made a mistake in my calculation.

examples.japanese: ミスらないように{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: Be careful not to make any mistakes.

notes:
ミスる is formed from the English word "miss" (as in making an error) + る. It's a common example of turning loanwords into casual verbs.

REGISTER:
This is casual/colloquial language. In formal contexts, use {間違|まちが}える, {失敗|しっぱい}する, or ミスをする.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ミスる: to make a mistake
- ミスった: messed up (past)
- ミスらないで: don't mess up
